# Region Intel

Region Intel is a Bun and TypeScript library for working with regional civic records. It maintains shared methods for evidence custody, corpus analysis, and publication. Regional deployments own their policy, source selection, accepted records, and delivery schedule.

For an offline first look, start with the [synthetic corpus fixture](../docs/examples/synthetic-corpus.json) and the [methods manuscript](../docs/manuscript/README.md). Regional deployment procedures are documented separately.

- [Documentation](../docs/README.md) covers setup, architecture, configuration, and operating contracts.
- [Regional methods manuscript](../docs/manuscript/README.md) describes the shared methods and gives a reproducible offline corpus example.
- [Deployment contract](../docs/deployments.md) describes how regional consumers install an immutable package revision.
- [Crescent compatibility guide](../docs/reference-application.md) documents the retained reference application.

The [historical Crescent manuscript](../docs/archive/crescent-manuscript/README.md) and [release history](../CHANGELOG.md) record their original evidence dates and scope.
